scenario: Package inventory paired with a separately specified graph test plan
expected_notes: The provided inventory/OSV/estimate contracts contain no dependency-edge field.
Use these packages to create assets and remediation candidates, then construct graph edges through the actual dependency-management mechanism.
Graph test plan: chain; fan-out; disconnected components; two disjoint cycles; one large SCC; self-loop if supported; mixed cyclic and acyclic components.
important_contract_notes: Inventory asset_id must equal the asset external_identifier used when registering assets.
Estimate keys must be <asset external_identifier>:<OSV vulnerability id>.
Only affected installations with a fixed version and matching estimate should become approved patch actions.
Package dependency edges are not represented in inventory_offline.json; do not invent a field for them.
